0022600168.text: The San Antonio Spurs (4-2) host the Utah Jazz (1-5) in this 2026-27 regular-season game, the Spurs' seventh of the season. The Spurs have won four straight, are 2-2 at home and 2-0 on the road, and sit 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, and 5th in the West, while Utah has lost four straight, is 1-4 at home, and sits 5th in the Northwest, 3.5 games back, and 14th in the West. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 117-111 win in Salt Lake City on October 28, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
